description: Get reference documentation for the core Orderly trading API: REST endpoints, WebSocket streams, or authentication. For `rest` or `websocket`, omitting `endpoint` lists every endpoint or stream with base URLs and auth requirements; supplying `endpoint` fuzzy-matches one item and returns its method/path or topic, auth, rate limits, parameters, message formats, and a TypeScript example. `type: 'auth'` returns the signing flow and ignores `endpoint`. Read-only bundled docs — it does not call the API and requires no credentials, rate limits, or side effects. Use `type` alone to discover valid names, then `endpoint` for detail; for historical analytics use get_indexer_api_info, for zero-auth public data use get_public_info_api_info, for DEX management use get_orderly_one_api_info, and for vault data use get_strategy_vault_api_info.
name: get_api_info
